test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 14 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A car moves at the speed of 108 km/hr after repairing and moves at the speed of 72 km/hr before repairing. It covers a distance of x km in 3 hours after repairing. How much time will it take to cover a distance of 5 x km before repairing?
solution:
**Given:**

Speed after repairing = 108 km/hr

Speed before repairing = 72 km/hr

Distance covered after repairing = x km

Time taken after repairing = 3 hours

**Concept Used:**

Time = Distance/Speed

Distance = Time × Speed

**Calculation:**

Distance covered after repairing = x km

x = 108 × 3 = 324 km

Distance before repairing = 5x

5 × 324 = 1620

Time before repairing = 1620/72

135/6 = 22 hours 30 minutes

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**
